state: local SQLite author validation; not integrated MAIN or deployed

allergies.foods: catalog food ID array; maximum 250; unique canonical sorted on server

invariants: not_reported preserves unknown; none_reported is a person's declaration without clinical assurance
reported requires at least one known food ID or other_reported true
all other statuses require empty foods and other_reported false
any reported allergy or professional_review_requested true prevents automated generation at every subscription tier
no approval flag, free text, ingredient inference, allergen taxonomy or cross-contact guarantee
existing alimentos_excluidos remains separate and always enforced
omission or null in partial update preserves the persisted declaration
explicit changes submit one complete valid object; saving is explicit
declaration values and their derived digest are not analytics, logs, browser storage or followup task data
authorization: Existing identity/tenant/role checks; no new client-supplied authority or review bypass
uncertainty: Existing compensation or publication uncertainty retains its 503 contract; never infer refund from an unknown outcome
privacy: no-store/no-referrer; validation errors never echo declaration values
